top_choice_rationale: P001 most convincingly joins a fundamental, clearly delimited discovery in GLP-1 physiology with mature and broad therapeutic benefit in diabetes and obesity. Its citation must remain confined to physiology that enabled treatment, preserving a defensible Holst-Mojsov-Drucker allocation without claiming credit for all later drug development.
